findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 58 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with both the superior mesenteric vein and the splenic vein, suggesting potential invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. Contact of more than 180° with the splenic artery is also noted, indicating possible invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastasis is observed in one node at station 14t. No other metastases are observed.
